egress.terms: PulsedMedia M10G Storage Box: Internet egress Unlimited@100Mbps (~30TB/Month / ~1TB/Day); Ulož.to free plans: 150 GB for data transfer/month

interface_detail: Hetzner Storage Box: FTP/FTPS, SFTP/SCP, rsync/BorgBackup, SMB/CIFS, HTTPS/WebDAV; PulsedMedia M10G Storage Box: SSH, SCP, SFTP, FTP(S), HTTPS, SSHFS, Rsync, Rclone, Restic, Borg backup
tooling: S3 is not among the access methods listed by Hetzner Storage Box or PulsedMedia M10G; the PulsedMedia M10G Storage Box lists Rclone, and Hetzner lists SFTP, rsync, BorgBackup and WebDAV, so the lack of an S3 endpoint is a tooling note, not a verdict reason
